transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. Um... well, what really made me come in today is that things at work have been pretty overwhelming lately. I'm a retail buyer, and I just can't shake this feeling that people at my job, and even some of the vendors, are tracking my buys. 

It feels like they're messing with the launch numbers on purpose just to make me look stupid. My supervisor keeps sitting me down and showing me the reports, telling me they don't prove any of that is happening, but... I just can't let it go. It's really been getting to me, so I figured I needed to talk to someone.
Aside from these thoughts about your work, have you ever heard, seen, or smelled things that other people around you couldn't perceive?

Yeah, actually... I have. Sometimes when I'm in the stockroom at work, or if I'm driving back from a vendor meeting, I'll hear a man's voice. It sounds like it's coming from right behind me. He'll say things like, "Move faster, Scott," or he'll just start laughing at my picks. But whenever I turn around to see who it is, nobody is there.
Have you noticed any times where your thoughts feel jumbled, or people have told you that your speech is difficult to follow?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. My thoughts feel pretty clear to me. And, um, nobody has ever told me I'm hard to understand or anything. I mean, my supervisor disagrees with what I'm saying about the vendors and the reports, but he always understands what I'm telling him. So, no, my speech is fine.
Outside of these experiences, have you noticed a loss of interest in your hobbies or a feeling that you just don't have the energy to do the things you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I guess I have. On my days off, I used to do a lot, but lately... I mostly just sit in my apartment. I'll scroll through sneaker drops on my phone, but I don't really care about them anymore. And my friends will text me to play volleyball or go to gallery nights, which I used to love, but I just dodge their messages. It honestly just feels like too much work to even type out an answer. I just don't have the energy for it.
How long have you been experiencing these thoughts about your coworkers and hearing this voice?

I'd say it's been... roughly ten months now. Yeah, about ten months since I started having those thoughts about everyone at work, and that's around the exact same time I started hearing the voice, too.

When you are talking to your friends or supervisor, do you feel like your emotions match what you are talking about, or do you feel like your face or voice might seem flat or empty regardless of the situation?

I don't think so. I mean, nobody has ever mentioned that my face looks blank or my voice sounds flat. When I'm talking to my supervisor about the vendors, I'm pretty sure I show how frustrated I am. And when I do actually talk to my friends, I feel like my reactions are normal. So, no, I haven't noticed anything like that.

Have you noticed any changes in your ability to take care of your daily hygiene, like showering or brushing your teeth, or have you found yourself acting in ways that seem disorganized or out of place to others?

No, I haven't really had any issues with that. I still shower every morning before work and brush my teeth... all that stuff is normal. And I don't think I've been acting weird or out of place, at least not that anyone has pointed out to me. I just do my normal routine, honestly.

Are your concerns limited specifically to the people at work and the vendors, or have you felt like other things, such as the television, the radio, or people you don't even know, are also sending you special messages or focusing on you?

No, it's really just the people at work and the vendors. I haven't noticed anything like that with the TV or radio, and strangers don't seem to be paying any special attention to me. It's just the situation at my job that I'm worried about.

When you feel like you don't have the energy to do things and are avoiding your friends, do those feelings of low mood or lack of energy happen at the same time as the thoughts about your coworkers and the voice you hear?

No, they don't really happen at the same time. The stuff with my coworkers and the vendors, and hearing that voice... that's been going on for a while now. But the low energy and not wanting to see my friends, that comes and goes. Sometimes I feel really down and exhausted, but the worries about work are just kind of always there, even when I'm feeling okay energy-wise.

When you think about these people tracking your work, do you believe they are doing this in a way that is realistically possible, such as by monitoring your computer logs or files, or do you feel there is something more unusual or impossible happening, like them using mind-reading or secret technology to track you?

No, nothing like mind-reading or anything impossible like that. I mean, they don't need to do anything like that. Everything I do as a buyer is on the computer anyway. They can just look at my logs or check the purchase orders I put in. It's all right there in the system, so it's just regular computer tracking. Nothing secret or out of the ordinary.
